Subject: Getting started: marketplace listing & PO flow

Hi Markus —

Thanks for taking the time to help us get listed on Redwood's marketplace. We run procurement through central finance and will need a clear PO flow, payor mapping, and any marketplace-specific billing steps to share with our AP team.

Quick questions to start:
- Do you require a signed master agreement before the marketplace listing goes live, or can we rely on marketplace terms and then surface a separate PO to activate billing?
- Is there a vendor intake form you want completed (tax, remittance, contact info)?
- Who should our finance team send the PO to, and is there a preferred PO template?

Attaching our W9 for reference. Happy to set up a quick call if that helps.

Thanks,
Alec
Sr. Partnerships, CloudRetailer
(alec.wang@cloudretailer.com)

Date: 2026-12-06T11:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Getting started: marketplace listing & PO flow

Hi Alec —

Great to meet you over email. Short answers up front: marketplace listing can go live under marketplace terms; billing activation and invoice/P O handling are separate and we typically require a PO to map to your tenant for invoicing. Below is the typical intake we ask from marketplace sellers: 

1) Completed vendor onboarding form (we prefer PDF).
2) W9 or equivalent tax form (you already attached — thanks).
3) Signed payment terms via DocuSign OR a PO with standard payment terms (Net 30 by default).
4) Payor mapping: who is the remit-to entity + billing contact.

I've attached our marketplace onboarding form and a PO template for your AP. Vanessa (cc'd) is our marketplace procurement lead and will own the activation queue; Kimberly can advise on tax/enterprise exceptions.

Next steps:
- Please complete redwood_marketplace_onboarding_form.pdf and return with remit-to and billing contact.
- If you prefer the DocuSign route for MSA, we'll send a link; otherwise, the PO + onboarding form is sufficient to start billing mapping.

If you want, I can run a short checklist with your AP team this week. Proposed times: Tue/Wed morning PST.

Best,
Markus Klein
Head of Vendor Ops, Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_marketplace_onboarding_form.pdf; po_template_markus_v1.docx

Hi Alec/Priya —

Looping in specifics from the marketplace side: when you complete the onboarding form, please include the following fields to avoid delays in payor mapping and listing activation: 
- Legal entity name (exact match to your tax docs)
- Remit-to address and ACH wiring details (if applicable)
- Billing email + AP contact phone number
- Marketplace SKU owner (person responsible for listing updates)

PO routing:
- Send the PO to procurements@redwood-marketplace.com and cc: marketplace-billing@redwood.com.
- Our system supports multiple remit entities; include the entity short code in the PO (e.g., CR-US or CR-EU) and we will map it back to the correct tenant.

Exceptions: Kimberly will handle special tax or legal entity mapping; if you need the invoice routed to a different company within CloudRetailer, note that in the onboarding form and attach corporate certificates.

I can also share a short AP checklist tailored to AWS/Azure/GCP marketplace billing differences after I see the completed form.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Marketplace Procurement Lead, Redwood Inference

Attachment: (none)

Alec —

Following up to lock timelines. Thanks for the W9 and for confirming you'll fill the onboarding form. Quick checklist to keep us aligned: 

- [ ] Return completed redwood_marketplace_onboarding_form.pdf with remit-to + billing contact (due EOD 2026-12-15).
- [ ] If relying on PO: send PO to procurements@redwood-marketplace.com (use PO template attached).
- [ ] If you want MSA: let us know and we'll send DocuSign (expect ~3 business days for signback).
- [ ] Provide corporate certificate if remit-to entity differs from W9 (for exceptions routing).

We aim to map payor and enable billing within 3 business days of receiving the completed form + PO. Vanessa will post the AP checklist for marketplace-specific nuances for AWS/Azure/GCP once your form arrives.

If helpful, I'm happy to run a 20-minute onboarding walk-through with your AP on Dec 16 (10:00 AM PST). Please confirm and I'll send a calendar invite.

Best,
Markus
